newsitem.title: INDIA: India minister favours diesel, LPG price hikes-UNI.
newsitem.headline: India minister favours diesel, LPG price hikes-UNI.

text.p: India's junior Petroleum Minister T.R. Balu has recommended a 15-20 percent hike in state -controlled prices of diesel and liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), United News of India said on Thursday.
Balu, during a meeting with Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral and Finance Minister P.Chidambaram, also recommended that prices of gasoline and kerosene be left unchanged.

Both Gujral and Chidmabaram have said the government must decide soon how to pay off money owed to oil companies, which totalled 155 billion rupees ($4.3 billion) at the end of March, for selling subsidised petroleum products below market prices.
Balu has previously said the government should explore alternatives to price hikes, like reductions in import duties on crude oil.
